Duo Health is committed to building an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome clinicians and healthcare professionals from diverse backgrounds who are passionate about making a meaningful difference for patients living with complex chronic conditions.

**Role Overview**

Care navigators are a critical part of our care team. They coordinate care, close gaps, and help ensure patients receive the right services at the right time, directly supporting quality measure performance and patient outcomes. The Senior Care Navigator Transformation Lead is responsible for building, developing, and leading this workforce.

This role owns how care navigators are onboarded, trained, coached, and held accountable for results. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who understands the work of a medical assistant and care navigator firsthand and is passionate about helping frontline team members grow.

**This is a remote position, but we require candidates to be located within one of our clinical market regions in Arizona or Florida.**

Onboarding and Training

* Design, deliver, and continuously improve the onboarding program for new care navigators, including care coordination workflows, documentation standards, patient communication, and quality measure expectations.

* Define role competencies, onboarding milestones, and readiness criteria.

* Develop and maintain training materials, playbooks, and job aid documentation that reflect current clinical guidelines and organizational standards.

Ongoing Training and Shadowing

* Lead ongoing education for navigators, including skills refreshers, case reviews, and bootcamp training on new programs, tools, and initiatives.

* Conduct shadowing and observation of patient outreach, scheduling, and coordination activities to assess quality and share best practices.

* Identify team-wide knowledge gaps and create targeted learning solutions.

Quality and Care Coordination

* Ensure navigators have the knowledge, tools, and workflows to support quality measures, including preventive screenings, chronic condition management, and follow-up after transitions of care.

* Partner with clinical and quality teams to translate quality priorities into clear, practical navigator workflows.

* Monitor gap closure and other care coordination metrics and drive improvement.

Performance Management

* Establish and monitor performance expectations for navigators, including quality, productivity, outreach, documentation, and visit cadence metrics.

* Review performance data regularly and provide clear, actionable feedback.

* Partner with leadership and HR on performance improvement plans, recognition, and career development pathways.

Coaching and Mentoring

* Provide individualized coaching to navigators at all stages of their careers.

* Build a culture of psychological safety, continuous learning, and accountability.

* Mentor high-performing navigators and support advancement in career path.

* Support a team of care navigators including hiring, onboarding, and performance management.

Process Improvement

* Collaborate within transformation team, with market leadership and IT to align and improve navigator workflows in a cohesive care team model.

* Identify opportunities to standardize and improve workflows and lead change management efforts as the organization grows.

**Qualifications**

Required

* Background as a medical assistant, with direct experience in care coordination, care navigation, or a similar patient-facing clinical support role.

* Minimum 7 years of experience, including 3+ years in a management or supervisory role.

* Demonstrated experience managing, coaching, and developing a team, including performance management.

* Working knowledge of quality measures and care gap closure.

* Strong communication, facilitation, and training skills, with the ability to teach practical workflows clearly.

* Comfort using data and dashboards to evaluate performance and drive improvement.

* Relevant certification (e.g., CMA, RMA) preferred or required.

Preferred

* Experience in value-based care environments.

* Experience with home-based care models.

* Experience with CKD and ESRD patient populations.

* Experience building or scaling onboarding and training programs.

* Background in change management or process improvement.

Core Competencies

* Care coordination expertise

* Coaching and feedback skills

* Empathy and emotional intelligence

* Accountability and results orientation

* Adaptability in a fast-paced, growing environment

* Collaboration across clinical and operational teams

Working Conditions

* Travel up to 25% to support field-based teams and in-person training.

* Standard business hours with occasional flexibility for training sessions and team needs.

**Benefits**

* 401(k) with company matching

* Malpractice insurance fully covered

### **Patient Intake Coordinator - Specialty Pharmacy**

* 52106

* Remote, United States

* Full Time

**POSITION SUMMARY**:

  
  

Working as a drug access liaison specialist, supports patients, caregivers, providers, and pharmacies in navigating insurance benefits for all medications that are administered in hospital clinics, infusion centers, and/or home settings. The drug access liaison specialist’s role must understand how to navigate payer medical benefits policies and procedures to ensure patients appropriately receive their prescribed injectable therapies. This person needs to have a strong understanding and ability to identify patient medical information. This role requires the ability to independently interpret medical terminology, which may include but is not limited to an understanding of past medical histories, diagnosis, laboratory, and pathology results. Additionally, this person should have knowledge of medical billing coding in three areas of the site of care: provider, home infusion, and hospital billing. Under the direct supervision of the Manager of Drug Access, this person will identify patient insurance benefits, submit all required medical documentation to the payer for approval, and assist the patient in accessing the drug through the most appropriate site of care.

  
  

**Position**: Patient Intake Coordinator

**Department**: Pharmacy - Medical Benefit Authorization

**Schedule**: Full time

  
  

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES**

* An understanding of basic clinical skills related to medical terminology and coding for different disease states or medical conditions
* Skilled communicator with interpersonal communication skills that interact with carrier representatives, patients, and providers
* Comprehensively review patient insurance benefits to navigate drug access barriers
* Understands significant major medical policies as they relate to site of care, medical necessity and, if applicable, pharmacy benefits
* Triage and coordinate patients to the appropriate site of care to ensure patients are accurately prescribed, and receive prescribed drug promptly
  + Includes understanding of drug access through hospital, home infusion, and pharmacy points of access
* Ability to review patient medical information through the hospital’s electronic medical records
* Liaise with patient’s relevant health care providers to support patient’s access to therapy and support services.
* Gather medical information and submit timely prior authorization for medications based on payer medical policies
  + Including but not limited to, the oversight of all authorizations and benefits related to medications that a healthcare provider administers
  + Understand prior authorization requirements, including dates of expiration, maximum units/doses
* Gather and assist in the management of data reports related to reimbursement and drug access services
  + Identify and understand medical coding billing errors
* Provide assistance to management for all payer audits, collect and distribute pertinent patient information
* Have a strong understanding of Medicare payment policies
  + Ability to screen patients for medical necessity based on Medicare LCD and NCD requirements
* Support the Drug Access Hub as needed
* Refer patient to pharmacy Financial Assistance Team when appropriate
* Multitasking; ability to complete multiple projects on time.
* Establish milestone and checkpoints to ensure successful work/project completion; follows up on work efforts and takes corrective steps when needed to ensure work remains on track
  

  

Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards

  
  

**(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).**

  
  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

  
  

**EDUCATION:**

* High school Diploma or equivalent is required
* Associate or Bachelor’s degree (preferred)
  

  

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:**

* Prior Authorization Certified Specialist program completion within the first 12 months of hire.
* Pharmacy Technician National Certification (preferred)
  

  

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Requires at least five years of experience working with insurance companies on appropriate billing for private or third party reimbursement, managed care, or clinical support
* Experience within a healthcare setting, such as a physician practice, patient assistance program, or similar pharmaceutical/biological support program, is preferred.
* Knowledge of private payer, Medicare and Medicaid structure, and specialty pharmacy and retail pharmacy processes
* Knowledge of operational processes within a physician’s office and/or infusion center, specifically related to prior authorizations
* Ability to communicate reimbursement and access topics concisely and clearly to provider staff
* Reviewing patient insurance benefit options and validating prior authorization requirements
* Identifying alternate funding/financial assistance programs
* Coordinating with hospital patient support services programs representatives
* Proven ability to collaborate and work in teams to achieve results in a complex, fast-paced service environment
  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSA):**

* Excellent English oral and written communication skills are required, as well as the ability to communicate professionally over the phone.
* Excellent interpersonal skills to provide superb personalized customer service and to instill confidence and to advocate for patients; ability to explain required information to customers in a comprehensible manner.
* Other professional skills and qualities: proactive demeanor, independently problem solve, organized, detail oriented, ability to self-direct through multitasking and prioritizing, dependable, empathetic, focused on quality service,

jobs.title: Food Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Foodsmart:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

As the Food Operations Manager, you'll be the face of Foodsmart's food operations to our health plan and payer clients, and the person who makes sure members get the right food, on time. You'll report to the Senior Director of Client Operations and help lead the team that runs our food benefit programs end to end.

Foodsmart’s food benefit programs connect clinical nutrition care to real food getting to members’ homes. That means working closely with health plan clients, food vendors, and our clinical teams, with data moving between all of them. You’ll own how that work runs day to day, make sure it works for members and clients, and dig into why when it doesn’t. This role suits someone who is confident with clients, rigorous about root causes, great at organizing complex processes, and comfortable with ambiguity in a growing, evolving program.

### **You will:**

* Design and own the workflows that run food operations, both internally and together with clients: define how food is assessed, approved, and shipped, explain why each step exists and what data we need from the client and what we provide, and secure client buy-in
* Bring internal teams together to follow those workflows consistently, and organize and standardize processes and SOPs across the food operations team
* Oversee the flow from clinician assessment through payer approval to vendor fulfillment, and make sure every handoff works
* Coordinate with our multiple food vendors and operationalize processes across all of them, holding them to service and quality standards
* Lead vendor change management: when something changes, such as a file design, get buy-in from every vendor, explain what is happening, and coordinate timing with them before implementing
* Partner with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot and implement our new food benefit management (FBM) system, including testing, rollout, and team training
* Manage data exchanges with clients and vendors, including SFTP file transfers and file design, and resolve data quality issues
* Serve as a client-facing lead for food operations, speaking with payer and health plan clients about incidents, program performance, and escalations with confidence and clarity
* Manage and resolve escalations from clients, vendors, and internal teams, and keep everyone updated until each one is closed
* Run root cause analysis when food doesn't ship correctly, and drive the fixes that keep it from happening again
* Dig into operational data in Excel to find out what's going on, and build reports for the team, clients, and business reviews
* Lead and develop the food operations team, balance workload among team members, and manage internal escalations
* Flag risks, trends, and client feedback to leadership so we can improve our programs

### **You are:**

* Able to design a workflow and explain it clearly to a client: what the workflow is, why it works the way it does, what data we need from them, and what data we will provide in return
* Someone who can get internal teams to adopt and follow new processes, working well with Product, Engineering, clinical, and vendor teams and winning buy-in from people who don't report to you
* Highly organized and a true project manager, capable of bringing structure to messy processes and making them repeatable
* Confident and polished with clients, and comfortable owning a conversation about an incident or escalation
* Curious and rigorous, and keep digging into the data until you find the root cause
* Committed to following through and responding on time
* A manager who can lead with fairness and empathy while keeping workloads balanced across a team
* Interested in our mission to expand access to nutritious food for unde

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

The Dropbox Business Strategy & Operations team unlocks the company's full potential by driving strategic initiatives and promoting operational excellence. We combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to tackle Dropbox’s biggest opportunities and challenges across all business functions. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance, we translate our strategic vision into actionable plans that foster growth, optimize performance, and facilitate informed decision-making. Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Onboarding & Implementation**

* Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.
* Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.

$75,000-$100,000

The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  

### **About Us**

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics.

We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. jobs.description:
### **About Synapticure**

Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

Our business is powered by two connected engines.

**The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)**

A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

**The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)**

Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.

### **About the Role**

Synapticure is dedicated to ensuring all individuals living with neurodegenerative diseases have equitable access to the highest standard of care while fueling the advancement of personalized treatments. We create a guided, compassionate journey for every patient, caregiver, and family, educating and empowering them while facilitating access to critical tests and leading specialists across the United States.

As a Care Team Intake Specialist, you will be the welcoming first point of contact for members, caregivers, and loved ones navigating neurodegenerative conditions. You will drive essential clinical and administrative support functions, including scheduling, registration, referrals, and prior authorizations, serving as a trusted representative of Synapticure to our members, external healthcare organizations, and payer partners.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful, daily impact on people's lives within a mission-driven, rapidly evolving environment. We are looking for an empathetic, curious, and organized communicator who thrives in collaborative spaces and is committed to delivering respectful, culturally responsive, and accessible care to diverse communities.

### **The Day to Day**

* Conduct welcoming, empathetic intake calls with new patients and caregivers to gather medical histories, current and past provider details, and insurance information.

* Proactively manage cancellations, rescheduling requests, and appointment reminders via phone, video, and digital communication tools.
* Collaborate closely with the multidisciplinary care team to coordinate care, complete visit-related tasks, and execute FMLA forms.
* Advocate on behalf of patients and families with clinical providers, billing departments, and insurance partners while maintaining strict adherence to HIPAA guidelines.

**Operations, Documentation & Follow-Up**

* Request, collect, and audit external medical records, member consents, and HIPAA forms to ensure care teams have complete information prior to appointments.
* Conduct insurance eligibility checks and assist with prior authorizations and referral management.
* Accurately document member clinical and demographic data, calls, and correspondence in our Electronic Health Record (EHR) and care facilitation platforms in a timely manner.
* Manage incoming and outgoing communications, including faxes, digital messages, and mailed member resources.
* Follow standardized operating procedures and quality assurance protocols while remaining adaptable to evolving workflows and priorities.
* Generate standard operational reports and support additional care team initiatives as needed.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 1-2+ years of experience in patient communication, care coordination, medical scheduling, or managing referrals and prior authorizations.
* Comfort with digital communication tools, telehealth platforms, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, and standard office technology.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy guidelines and handling confidential medical records.
* Strong active listening skills and the ability to communicate clearly, patiently, and non-judgmentally with individuals from diverse backgrounds and varying accessibility needs.
* Ability to stay organized, prioritize tasks effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.title: Onboarding Technician
jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**

Lumistry began as a phone system for independent pharmacies and grew, product by product, into the communication and workflow platform those pharmacies run on today. Each addition answered a problem pharmacists told us about: phones that never stop ringing, education that gets thrown away, patients who drift to the chains.

Today, Lumistry serves more than 9,000 pharmacies with technology built for pharmacy. Our solutions help pharmacies engage patients, automate work, improve health literacy, reduce operating costs, and grow their businesses. Now we are using AI to take repetitive work off pharmacy teams so they can spend more time with patients.

**The Opportunity**

You know how much of the day goes to repetitive tasks in the pharmacy management system (PMS), like processing refills and entering e-scripts. Our AI-powered automation does that work for the pharmacy team.

As an Onboarding Technician, you instruct an automation agent on how each pharmacy works. You map out each task step by step, think through every “if this happens, then do that,” build it in our workflow builder, and keep it running smoothly once it goes live. The job sits between two worlds. On one side are pharmacy technicians who know their PMS cold but do not think in terms of automation logic. On the other is an automation that will do exactly what you tell it, in exactly the order you tell it, and will stop when reality does not match what you wrote.

Your job is to turn the first into the second, prove it works, and fix it fast when it breaks.

**What You'll Do**

* Set up new pharmacies on our platform and make sure the device that runs their automation is connected and ready.
* Meet with pharmacy teams, learn how they work in their PMS, and map each task step by step, including the decisions and exceptions along the way.
* Build, test, and update automated workflows in our workflow builder for each PMS we support.
* Work with our engineers on the technical pieces, like how the automation recognizes PMS screens and fields, and confirm everything works in the pharmacy.
* Check automation runs every day, figure out why something stopped or failed, and fix it.
* Update workflows when a PMS releases a new version.
* Help grow a library of proven workflow templates so each new pharmacy goes live faster.
* Escalate issues you cannot solve, with screenshots, the step that failed, and what you have already tried.

**What You Bring**

* Pharmacy experience using a pharmacy management system (PMS).
* Logical, critical thinking. You can break a process into steps, think through every “if this, then that,” and figure out why something works nine times out of 10 but fails on the tenth.
* The ability to interview pharmacy staff about how they work: ask follow-up questions, catch the steps they skip because they are second nature, and confirm what you heard.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write instructions others can follow and can calmly explain an issue to a pharmacy.

**Other Details**

* Business hours across U.S. time zones, with occasional after-hours work for go-lives, PMS updates, and a shared on-call rotation as we grow.
* Occasional travel to pharmacies to set up devices and see workflows firsthand.
* You will be trained on our tools and workflows, and your skills in automation and AI will grow with the product.

**Compensation**

The approximate range for this role is $70,000 to $75,000.

### **Benefits**

Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

### **Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry**

Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

### **Accessibility**

We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please reach out.

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, West
jobs.description:
**Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?**

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

The Regional Account Manager will lead a team of Account Managers in fostering and expanding relationships with Tempus's client base. This role is critical in ensuring client satisfaction, retention, and growth through strategic account management and collaboration with Clinical Account Executives. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in healthcare sales, account management, and a deep understanding of Tempus's product offerings, including algorithmic tests and add-ons.

**Key** **Responsibilities:**

  

* Lead and mentor a team of Clinical Account Associates in the execution of their duties to gain, retain, and support clients as part of the customer success organization.
* Collaborate with the Customer Success leadership to ensure comprehensive support, including sample and order tracking, and to escalate and resolve issues efficiently.
* Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring best practices are followed and partnerships with sales representatives are leveraged.
* Collaborate with sales to identify and capitalize on opportunities for Tempus's algorithmic tests and add-ons.
* Drive initiatives to improve workflow efficiencies and support care teams with effective ordering methods and workflows.
* Analyze highest opportunities for retention in areas and coach teams to improve care teams workflow, in turn improving pTaT and customer experience.
* Promote the adoption of online ordering through Tempus Hub and EMR integrations among the client base.
* Conduct competitive analysis and collect feedback from accounts and sales representatives to continuously improve the Tempus experience.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through on-site support and regular, proactive communication.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Life Science, Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in account management or sales within the healthcare or biotechnology industry, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success in client retention and account growth.
* In-depth knowledge of healthcare data, AI applications, and the competitive landscape.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Travel as needed for client engagement and team support

$75,000-$100,000

The expected salary range above is applicable if the role is performed from California and may vary for other locations (Colorado, Illinois, New York). Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position.

Additionally, ***for remote roles open to individuals in unincorporated Los Angeles*** *– including remote roles-* Tempus reasonably believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: engaging positively with customers and other employees; accessing confidential information, including intellectual property, trade secrets, and protected health information; and appropriately handling such information in accordance with legal and ethical standards. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  

### **About Us**

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics.

We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

### **Why Work Here?**

We’re looking for people who can change the world.

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**

The Materials Program Manager is a critical cross-functional role responsible for NPI material planning across our facilities; controlling BOM data, translating production demand into supply signals internally and externally, managing inventory, and working directly with procurement, engineering, and operations teams to ensure material readiness supports customer demand. This role sits at the heart of Hadrian’s supply chain and directly impacts our ability to deliver on time to our customers. This person will be responsible for supporting the prototype, development build and rate ramp phase of a program until the successful transition to sustaining management.

**What You’ll Do**

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Lead ownership and governance of critical master data (BOMs, make/buy, item attributes, lead times, planning parameters, and engineering change impacts) to ensure MRP and planning systems reflect the current design, production and supplier plan of record.
* Plan, organize, direct and execute material readiness activities across engineering, operations and supply chain to support development through rate production.
* Manage the Clear-to-Build (CTB) process internally and with suppliers, providing visibility to supply availability, inventory levels, and risk assessments and mitigation
* Ensure supply plans meet production deadlines; proactively identify and mitigate risks to supply continuity.
* Coordinate with engineering, operations, and quality teams to manage material change cut-ins, reduce obsolescence, and eliminate quality-driven supply disruptions
* Partner with procurement and operations on advanced supply chain strategies including long-term purchasing and strategic safety stock.
* Proactively manage inventory to prevent stock-outs and own allocation of constrained supply.
* Analyze supply chain data and report on MRP health metrics relative to factory production goals and delivery commitments.
* Own the leadership communication on the program to all key stakeholders: program management, operations, engineering & supply chain.
* Proactively update operations leadership and engineering on critical supply issues requiring escalation.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, operations, engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in material program management, material planning, production planning, supply chain management, purchasing, or operations.
* Track record supporting material planning for new product introduction (NPI) from prototype through rate production
* Experience working within MRP or ERP systems
* Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data to drive supply planning decisions
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to escalate supply risks clearly to cross-functional stakeholders
* Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to respond quickly in a fast-moving, ever-changing environment

**What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience navigating multi-tier BOMs and complex work orders in a high-mix manufacturing environment
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, macros); SQL or Power BI experience a plus.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, or other high-precision, regulated manufacturing environments

**Compensation**

For this role, the target salary range is **$100,000 - $175,000** (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Must be a US Citizen or permanent resident
* Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Engineering, or related field. Four additional years of relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree
* 5 years of experience, including materials management, supply chain, or Materials & Process Engineering, preferably within aerospace or composites manufacturing
* Understanding of composite raw material properties, handling requirements, and storage/shelf-life considerations
* Experience managing vendor relationships, including performance monitoring and quality/cost improvement initiatives
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with composite prepreg materials (carbon fiber, film adhesives, core materials, syntactic foam, etc.)
* Familiarity with FileMaker Pro and/or IFS or similar inventory/ERP systems
* Experience supporting IRAD or new material development initiatives
* Working knowledge of Materials & Process Engineering processes, incoming inspection, and NCR disposition
* Experience in a regulated aerospace manufacturing environment (AS9100/ISO 9001)
* Strong project management skills, including experience developing and implementing project management tools or systems (e.g., tracking tools, dashboards, or planning templates)

**Work Schedule**

**JOB** **TITLE****:** Project Manager 1  
**FLSA:** Exempt position  
**LOCATION**: Fremont, CA (Onsite)  
**SALARY**: $75,000 - $108,000

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Project Manager (Level 1) is responsible for executing assigned manufacturing projects under the guidance of a Program Manager or senior Project Manager. This role takes the execution of defined project scopes, manages day-to-day coordination, tracks progress against schedules, and drives task completion across cross-functional teams. While guidance is provided, Level 1 Project Managers are expected to work independently on assigned responsibilities, proactively identify issues, and take initiative in following up on actions and deliverables.

  

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage assigned manufacturing projects or project components, taking ownership of schedules, task tracking, and execution within defined scope. Ensure execution meets defined quality, quantity, and delivery commitments.

* Develop and maintain project timelines based on customer requirements, material readiness, and available production resources.

* Coordinate day-to-day activities with Engineering, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and other internal teams to ensure project progress aligns with plan.

* Actively monitor project status, identify risks or delays, and escalate issues with proposed options or recommendations when needed.

* Track production progress and resource availability, following up with responsible teams to close gaps.

* Conduct routine project meetings or working sessions as assigned; document action items and ensure timely follow-through.

* Prepare and deliver accurate project status updates and reports to Program Managers and internal stakeholders.

* Apply standard project management tools, templates, and processes to ensure consistency and transparency.

* Continuously build knowledge of manufacturing operations, workflows, and cross-functional dependencies to improve project execution.

  

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for assigned projects and deliverables.
* Ability to work independently while effectively leveraging guidance and feedback.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional coordination.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, assess impact, and escalate with context.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in tracking schedules, data, and commitments.
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with changing priorities.
* Collaborative interpersonal skills to maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* Entry-level professional experience, internships, or academic project work related to project coordination, manufacturing, operations, or business support is beneficial.

**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**

Hadrian is building and expanding factories and offices across the country, both greenfield (new construction) and brownfield (retrofits of existing buildings). As our IT Infrastructure Project Manager, Site Buildouts, you'll own the technology scope of these projects from the first site survey to the day the building goes live.

You'll partner with Security, Workplace, and Factory Development to define what each site needs, then work with architects, designers, the General Contractor, and trades like cabling vendors and electricians to design, procure, and build it. You won't pull every cable yourself, but you need to understand IT cabling, electrical, HVAC, networking, AV, and low-voltage security well enough to catch a bad design before it gets built.

Hadrian moves fast, and requirements are often still taking shape when a project kicks off. You'll run several projects at once and be expected to fill in the gaps: ask the right questions, recommend a path, and keep things moving. You'll use AI tools every day to help you keep up.

This is a full-time, on-site role based at our Torrance, CA HQ with 25-50% travel to project sites. It reports to David Chen, Director of IT.

**What You'll Do**

**Requirements & Design**

* Partner with Security, Workplace, and Factory Development to define each site's technology requirements (security systems and CMMC controls, offices and AV, production lines and shop-floor connectivity) and turn them into one agreed-upon IT scope
* When requirements are unclear, propose a recommended approach, document assumptions, and drive decisions
* Work with engineering teams to define MDF and IDF requirements: location, rack layout, power (circuits, receptacle types, UPS, and PDUs), cooling, and fiber and copper backbone
* Represent IT through each design phase (schematic design, design development, and construction documents), translating Hadrian standards into design requirements for architects and engineers
* Review drawings, panel schedules, RFIs, and submittals for cabling, power, HVAC, AV, and security
* Assess existing infrastructure on brownfield sites and plan phased cutovers that keep the business running

**Site Surveys & Inspections**

* Lead site surveys of new and prospective sites: existing cabling, electrical, HVAC, telecom rooms, carrier availability, and wireless coverage
* Walk active construction at key milestones to confirm cabling, power, cooling, and low-voltage work is built to spec while the walls are still open
* Document findings, track deficiencies, and follow up with the GC and vendors until they are fixed

**Procurement & Vendor Management**

* Own the IT budget for each project and manage change orders
* Write statements of work (SOWs) for low-voltage cabling and AV vendors that clearly define scope, deliverables, standards, schedule, and acceptance criteria
* Review vendor proposals and SOWs for gaps, exclusions, and assumptions before they are signed
* Run bids, select vendors, and hold them accountable to the SOW on quality, schedule, and scope
* Order long-lead equipment and ISP circuits early so they land when the schedule needs them
* Represent IT in OAC and site coordination meetings

**Project & Timeline Management**

* Run several projects at once, each at a different phase, and own an IT schedule for each that ties into construction and equipment install timelines
* Re-plan quickly when scope or timelines change, make tradeoff calls across projects, and communicate the impact clearly
* Track progress, milestones, risks, and dependencies in Smartsheet and Jira, and keep stakeholders updated
* Use AI tools in your daily work to draft SOWs, summarize RFIs, submittals, and meeting notes, compare vendor proposals, and build status updates faster
* Build repeatable templates (survey checklists, MDF/IDF specs, AV room standards, SOW templates) so each project goes faster than the last

**Turnover & Closeout**

* Own the IT punch list and collect test results, as-builts, and documentation from vendors
* Capture as-built information in Confluence (MDF/IDF layouts, rack elevations, cable and port maps, circuit and panel details, and test results) so every site has an accurate, up-to-date record
* Coordinate with Technical Field Engineers on deployment and go-live, confirm readiness with partner teams, and hand off to local and central IT

* Delivered both greenfield and brownfield projects for offices, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, labs, or data centers
* Experience working with architects, designers, MEP engineers, GCs, and trades from schematic design through closeout, and comfort with RFIs, submittals, and change orders

new_jobs.title: Human Resources Operations Coordinator

About Us

Homebridge serves a high risk, high needs, complex-diagnosed population with a combination of domestic, personal, and paramedical homecare functions funded through IHSS. Our work allows an often-underserved population to live safely in their community. Homebridge offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment with 350+ unionized field workers and 90+ internal office staff.

Position Summary

Homebridge is a dynamic work environment with 300+ unionized field workers and 100+ internal office staff. We serve a high-risk, high-needs population often underserved in our community. We seek a driven, personable, and organized Human Resources Operations Coordinator to join our team of dedicated staff in support of the community we serve.

Reporting to the Human Resources Supervisor, the HR Operations Coordinator oversees and plans the day-to-day operations of the HR Department and provides high-level operational and administrative support. The role manages the full pre-hire and onboarding experience for Home Care Providers (HCPs) and administrative staff, supports the Recruiting department, and owns the pre-hire and onboarding software. The Coordinator also participates in strategy and organizational projects that improve the effectiveness and efficiency of HR functions.

Success in this role comes from maintaining composure in a high-volume environment, managing varied priorities in a timely manner with great attention to detail, a strong customer service orientation, interest in advancing underserved populations, and a mature, professional attitude amid changing and sometimes challenging circumstances.

Essential Job Functions

Employee Support and Communication

* Provide exceptional customer service to employees, managers, applicants, and new hires; serve as the first line of response for inquiries about HR functions.
* Prepare and manage letters, notices, employment verifications, and other routine communications for current, former, and prospective employees and third parties.
* Prepare and manage communications for recruiting efforts internally and externally
* Respond to applicant and employee inquiries via phone, email and in person.

Recruiting and Pre-Hire

* Review new applications and move applicants through the candidate pipeline
* Coordinate and schedule phone, video, and in-person interviews between candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.

* Conduct phone screenings and interviews, as needed
* Extend verbal offers or notify candidates who are not moving forward.
* Draft and send offer letters and new hire packets
* Maintain accurate candidate records and update applicant tracking systems (ATS)
* Support career fairs, recruiting events, and special talent acquisition projects

Onboarding

* Manage onboarding for all new hires, including facilitating new hire orientation and enhancing the employees’ introductory experience.
* Create, collect, review, and audit new hire paperwork for completeness and accuracy, including I-9 validation through E-Verify.
* Maintain the pre-hire and onboarding applicant tracking system (ATS)
* Coordinate and facilitate work readiness, leadership, career options, and other workshops that strengthen workforce skills.

HR Operations, Records, and Compliance

* Maintain internal database records and HRIS records for new hires, terminations, and other status changes
* Manage and maintain all HR records accurately and confidentially, always protecting private employee information.
* Coordinate quarterly internal audits of personnel records to confirm proper filing practices and compliance.
* Compile reports, interpret data, and support the data dashboard; provide analysis as requested.
* Assist with employee questions or concerns regarding employee relations including but not limited to HRIS system, benefits, leaves, and day to day operations
* Manage employee leaves partnering with cross functional partners
* Assist with Workers Compensations claims

* Support special projects, process improvements, ad hoc requests, and other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

* Exceptional customer service and professional communication with employees, funders, vendors, and staff at all levels, including in challenging encounters.
* Compassionate and trustworthy
* Collaborative and flexible; keeps communication open across departments.
* Stays professional under pressure, with strong time management, urgency, and independent judgment across competing priorities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy; strict confidentiality.
* Self-starter who can work independently
* Committed to the Homebridge mission and ongoing HR learning.
* Working knowledge of HR operations and state and federal employment law.
* Experienced in Word, Outlook, Excel, and Google Docs; quickly learn ADP and the ATS.

Education and Experience

* Two to three years of administrative, high-volume staffing, or HR administration experience in a fast-paced environment, with a strong commitment to customer service.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Familiarity with human services and non-profits is a plus.
* Bilingual strongly preferred (Spanish or Cantonese)

Work Environment

This position is hybrid. When in the office, the role is primarily sedentary, typically involving desk work in a temperature-controlled environment within modular, individual or shared office space. **Location:** Berkeley, California. In person at the studio.

**Reports to:** Project lead; Principal

**FLSA status:** Nonexempt

**Schedule:** Monday trough Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM

**1. ABOUT Company:**

Company was founded to meet a growing need: a better way to design and build. The practice is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and provides architecture, interiors, design build, construction management, landscape, advisory, and development services. One multidisciplinary team of architects, designers, builders, managers, and strategists carries each project from idea to built work.

The firm is advancing a more integrated model of design build delivery, in which the people who design a project stay with it through construction, so that design intent carries from the first drawing to the finished building without a handoff.

The firm takes on residences, restaurants, hospitality, adaptive reuse, and multifamily projects, from ground up buildings to tenant improvements and small projects. Construction is performed by General Contractors, a licensed builder with its own build team and its own millwork.

**2. ROLE:**

The Designer and Project Coordinator is a design professional who supports project delivery across design and construction phases within the firm's architect led design build team. With a foundation in architectural training and a curiosity for building processes, this individual leads the firm's Revit modeling and visualization work and plays a key role in project documentation, consultant coordination, and jobsite integration.

The role offers exposure to all phases of project development, with mentorship from experienced Project Leads and the goal of leading a small project within the first year. Approximately 65 percent of the role is design and documentation, and 35 percent is project coordination and construction support.

**Project coordination**

* Track consultant deliverables, permit submittals, and project milestones.

* Bachelor's or master's degree in architecture.
* Minimum of five years of professional experience in architecture or construction.
* Advanced proficiency in Revit, and working knowledge of Rhino.
* Proficiency in rendering tools such as V-Ray and Enscape, and familiarity with Adobe CreativeSuite.

* Team mentality: You support others and ask for help when needed. You recognize that no task is too small, and you go above and beyond to help others.

**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs , LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

LifeMoves | Georgia Travis House (GTH) provides interim supportive housing in San Jose to 12 families and 15 single females. During their stay, clients participate in holistic services tailored to each household’s unique needs and goals. Clients receive support to build self-sufficiency and return to housing stability. The team supports clients with children’s support services, employment, housing, benefits, physical and behavioral health through case management, workshops, and connection to specialized resources.

The Georgia Travis House Case Manager plays a key role in supporting people moving toward safe, stable housing and greater self-sufficiency. This position provide case management services, life skills support, and resource connections. They work in partnership with clients to set goals, celebrate progress, and overcome challenges. Using a trauma-informed and strengths-based approach, this position builds trust and respect, making sure clients feel heard, valued, and supported throughout their journey.

Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.

The Interim Supportive Housing (ISH) Case Manager (CM) reports to the site Program Director and supports daily program operations and helps keep the site safe and welcoming for everyone. This role works closely with clients and staff to build a positive community. They help monitor the environment, respond to client needs, and ensure that all program rules are followed with fairness and respect. Additionally, this role supports service delivery by helping with client check-ins, group activities, and site coordination.

**Client Support and Case Management**

* Develop, implement, and revise individual case plans with housing/employment/benefit/health and well being tasks based on client strengths and goals.
* Support clients with tasks including but not limited to housing searches, employment preparation, benefits access, life skills development, build resumes, cover letters, and navigate employment and housing resources.
* Support clients with enrollment into benefit programs including but not limited to General Assistance, CalFresh, and Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants.
* Coordinate with health care access to understand and support client physical and behavioral health needs. Assist clients by scheduling medical appointments, arranging transportation, and accompanying them to appointments as needed.

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community partners by building strong relationships, connecting clients to needed resources and services, and educating the community on client needs and trauma-informed care.
* Coordinate with relevant public partners, for example probation officers, Veterans Affairs, Adult Protective Services (APS), Child Protective Services (CPS) and city, state, and federal agencies, to support client needs and program goals.

**Client Advocacy, Mediation, and Conflict Resolution**

* Serve as a liaison between clients and landlords, employers, or agencies to support successful outcomes. Provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.

**Data Tracking and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, case notes, reports, and program data in line with agency standards and confidentiality laws utilizing Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) and the LifeMoves internal client management system

* Provide crisis intervention and make referrals to appropriate services when needed.

**General Agency Responsibilities**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  

### **About Us**

Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics.

We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

### **Why Work Here?**

We’re looking for people who can change the world.

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

new_jobs.title: Associate Customer Support Specialist
new_jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

**More about our team and company:**

* Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
* Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

The Customer Support team is seeking a knowledgeable and customer-focused team member to join our team as an Associate Customer Support Specialist / Customer Support Specialist! As a member of the Support Team, you will be the first point of contact for our fleet management software, providing basic technical support and product knowledge to our customers. You will play a critical role in ensuring customer satisfaction, resolving complex technical issues, and delivering exceptional support experiences. This position requires a deep understanding of fleet management software, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively.

### **Who you are**

The ideal candidate for this role has served as the primary point of contact for basic technical support and product-related inquiries from customers in the software space. You've provided exceptional customer service through various channels, including phone and email while maintaining a high level of professionalism and empathy. The ideal candidate can demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of our fleet management software to customers, including a basic understanding of its features, functionalities, and integrations. Excelling in collaborative team environments, you will work closely with our Support Specialists and Shift Leads teams to escalate customer issues to the appropriate team. You continuously identify opportunities to improve the customer support process, including streamlining workflows, enhancing documentation, and implementing customer-focused initiatives. This role will report to our Customer Support Manager. **The schedule for this role is Monday through Friday from 11am - 8pm Eastern with Respect to Daylight Savings time.**

**Responsibilities**:

* Serve as the primary point of contact for basic technical support and product-related inquiries from customers using Fleetio.
* Provide exceptional customer service for tier 1 tickets via phone calls while maintaining a high level of professionalism and empathy.
* Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of our fleet management software, including a basic understanding of its features, functionalities, and integrations.
* Investigate complex software issues reported by customers, collaborating with Support Specialists, SME’s, Shift Leads, and Support Engineering teams to identify and escalate customer issues to the appropriate team.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve the customer support process, including streamlining workflows, enhancing documentation, and implementing customer-focused initiatives.

### **Your experience**

* Previous experience in a customer support or technical support role, preferably in the software industry.
* In-depth knowledge of fleet management software and related technologies is a plus!
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to customers clearly and concisely.
* Customer-centric mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional support experiences.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Proficiency in using customer support tools and software, including ticketing systems, CRM software, and remote support tools.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings or weekends to accommodate customer needs.

### **Benefits**

* Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
* Vision insurance
* Incentive stock options
* 401(k) match of 4%
* PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
* 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
* Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
* FSA & HSA options
* Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
* Community service funds
* Professional development funds
* Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
* Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
* Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
* Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
* Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

*Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.*

*This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.*

*If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.*
